metadata.description: Plugins from wei-ai-lab. Currently hosts clinical-trial-design, an end-to-end clinical trial design assistant.

plugins.name: clinical-trial-design
plugins.description: End-to-end clinical trial design assistant. R-backed computation (gsDesign / gsDesign2 / graphicalMCP). 9 MCP tools across single-primary endpoint design, multi-hypothesis multiplicity (co-primary, multi-population, Maurer-Bretz), Monte-Carlo verification, and Word/PDF reporting. Covers Phase 2 and Phase 3 confirmatory designs.
